content: npm registry checked directly: 'mac-oui-lookup' v1.1.4, zero deps, but unpacked size 1.75MB (bundles ~50K OUI entries as JSON) - too large to ship in a client JS bundle without code-splitting/lazy-loading. 'oui-data' v1.1.571 (used by silverwind/oui CLI, 107 GH stars) is the raw IEEE OUI database as JSON, 4.06MB unpacked / ~1.2MB gzip - same bundle-size problem, published very frequently (version number itself tracks freq of IEEE registry updates, up to v1.1.571). Neither of these off-the-shelf packages is directly embeddable client-side at that size; recommendation is a custom build-time script that downloads the raw IEEE CSVs and compacts them into a minimal integer-keyed lookup structure (e.g. Map<number,string> keyed by 24-bit OUI, JSON or binary), served either via a server-only API route (not bundled to client) or a lazy-loaded/code-split chunk only fetched on the MAC tool page.
